literal_meaning: প্রতিটি গাঁটে বুদ্ধি (every joint has intelligence)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গাঁটে গাঁটে বুদ্ধি, কখনো ধরা পড়ে না।
ব্যবসায়ে তার গাঁটে গাঁটে বুদ্ধি কাজে লাগে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is cunning to the core; he never gets caught.
His shrewd intelligence serves him well in business.
note: This idiom emphasizes intricate cleverness, often with a connotation of slyness in Bengali folklore and daily expressions.
